name: Historic City of Yazd
description: Yazd is a desert city in central Iran, about 270 km southeast of Isfahan, built almost entirely of mud brick. Its maze of sand-coloured lanes is topped with tall windcatchers that funnel breezes into the houses below. Underground qanal channels still bring water from afar. Among its bazaars, hammams, mosques, synagogues and Zoroastrian temples, you can wander a living desert town.
